subject: Recap & approval matrix — Redwood pilot with Pinebridge
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@pinebridge.ai>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@pinebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & suggested MAP — Redwood pilot with Pinebridge

Hi Elena, Tom —

Thanks again for sharing time earlier today. Quick recap from my side and a suggested approval matrix that I attached (Pinebridge_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx). I wanted to make the path to pilot as explicit as possible so we can align owners and dates.

Top pain points you reiterated:
- Latency and throughput variability on your real-time moderation model (esp. peak ecommerce traffic).
- Unit cost per inference rising with longer context windows and multiple models in parallel.
- Lack of consolidated observability across cloud regions and model variants.

Goals we agreed on:
- 90th percentile generation latency < 120ms for the critical endpoint (weekday peak).
- 20–30% reduction in per-token inference cost via batching + quantization recommendations.
- Deployment pattern that supports a private VPC for PHI-sensitive traffic.

Suggested mutual action plan (high level) — details in attached spreadsheet:
1) Pilot kickoff and test data exchange — owner: Tom Reeves — target: 2026-08-16
2) Baseline performance sweep (3 test scenarios) — owner: Redwood infra (Priya/Ben) — target: 2026-08-23
3) Optimization run (batching/quantize) and cost report — owner: Redwood runtime team (Connor) — target: 2026-09-06
4) Security & compliance sign-off (VPC/KMS) — owner: Pinebridge security (Elena) — target: 2026-09-13
5) Executive decision & procurement (SOW & pricing) — owner: Pinebridge procurement — target: 2026-09-20

Asks / next steps from you:
- Confirm the named decision-maker for procurement and legal (we have Elena and an initial name Tom gave, but please confirm).
- Share two anonymized sample payloads and typical peak QPS by 2026-08-10 so we can size capacity.
- Review the attached MAP and SOW draft and flag any redlines by 2026-08-09.

We can hold a short sync next Wed (2026-08-11) if you'd like to walk the plan together.

Attachments: Pinebridge_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx; SOW_Draft_Pinebridge_20260804.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@pinebridge.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.ai>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@pinebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & suggested MAP — Redwood pilot with Pinebridge

On Mon, 02 Aug 2026 at 10:15 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for sharing time earlier today. Quick recap from my side and a suggested approval matrix that I attached...

Priya — thanks, this is clear and helpful. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Decision-makers: Procurement lead is Maria Lopez (maria.lopez@pinebridge.ai). Legal approver is David Chen (david.chen@pinebridge.ai) — they will need a 72-hour review for any standard SOW.
- Timeline: procurement/review cadence looks like mid-late September — procurement team expects to present to execs on 2026-09-20.
- Data: we can share two trimmed payloads (redacted PII) by 2026-08-09; peak QPS currently ~180 on weekday evenings (Eastern) and ~60 off-peak.

A couple of notes on the SOW:
- Please add a short clause about data segregation in multi-tenant environments (we require explicit VPC + KMS key ownership for PHI projects).
- Pricing: procurement will expect a firm number for pilot months and unit price banding post-pilot. If you can provide a clean per-token estimate assuming our peak profile, that will speed internal sign-off.

We reviewed the MAP and have two internal suggestions: move the security sign-off earlier (we want to validate compliance before heavy optimization runs) and split the optimization run into two phases (cost first, then latency tuning).

Happy to take the MAP as-is as a starting point; we will return redlines on the SOW by Monday 2026-08-09.

Best,
Elena
Director of Security & Compliance
Pinebridge AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & suggested MAP — Redwood pilot with Pinebridge

Priya / Connor — quick internal note (putting this in thread for context).

Thanks Elena for the clarifications — Maria and David as procurement/legal owners makes sense. From a commercial perspective I'd like to tentatively offer a 25% pilot credit (applied to the first 90 days) conditional on signed SOW and redline turnaround by 2026-08-16. That gives us runway and shows commitment.

Connor — please scope the optimization run in two parts as Elena requested: (a) cost optimizations (batching + quantize) and (b) latency tuning. I think we can hit the cost target faster; latency tuning will need a second iteration once we validate baseline results.

I'll also prepare a short executive summary to include with the SOW that highlights latency targets and cost delta so Maria has a one-pager for her review.

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive

Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity on owners. Per the thread and internal alignment, I attached an updated MAP that moves the security/compliance sign-off earlier and splits the optimization into two stages (Pinebridge_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx -> v1.1). I also attached a clean SOW draft with the pilot-credit language Ben proposed (SOW_Draft_Pinebridge_20260804.pdf).

Updated milestones & owners (short):
- Data exchange & redacted payloads — owner: Tom Reeves — due: 2026-08-09
- Security & compliance validation (VPC/KMS) — owner: Elena Suarez — due: 2026-08-16
- Baseline performance sweep — owner: Redwood (Connor) — due: 2026-08-23
- Cost optimization phase (batching + quant) — owner: Connor — due: 2026-09-03
- Latency tuning phase — owner: Redwood runtime — due: 2026-09-10
- Procurement decision & SOW sign — owner: Maria Lopez (Pinebridge) — target: 2026-09-20

Next meeting: propose Mon, 2026-08-11 @ 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — 30 minutes to walk the MAP and confirm redlines. If that works I'll send a calendar invite and attach the executive one-pager.

If you have any immediate redlines to the SOW, please send them to me and Maria (cc'd?) — Maria is not on this thread yet; feel free to loop her in when convenient.

Thanks all — Priya
